description: Shell script for performance testing of git-log's --grep regex engines with various patterns and options. It sets up environment variables, runs tests comparing different grep engines, and verifies that the outputs are consistent across engines.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out the worktree state for testing.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance test with specified engine and options.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if prerequisite tools or conditions are available.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Verifies that the test conditions are successful.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to ensure they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of all tests.
